messages.subject: Problems with Simple Tutorial
parts:
Dear All,
Most likely the trouble I am having is not an issue with ggvis per se,
but an indication that there is something odd un the configuration of
my system (Debian testing).
In brief: I installed ggvis without problems from CRAN.
However, then I decided to run the very simple tutorial at

http://ggvis.rstudio.com/cookbook.html

#############################################
library(ggvis)
library(dplyr)
mtcars %>% ggvis(~wt, ~mpg) %>% layer_points()
###################################

the result is that Calibre (yes, an ebook management tool!) opens and
adds a zip file to its catalogue.
All in all, I suppose the right object is created by my system, but it
is definitely handled by the wrong application.
Any idea about how to fix this?
Many thanks

Lorenzo
